result.plainSummary: Current screenshots cover the changed screens, valid coverage no longer gets rejected, and all three slices pass their regression checks.
result.summary: Current-source review covers W-014 SLC-01, SLC-02 and SLC-03. Reran node --test packages/ledger/dist/evidence/visual.break.test.js packages/ledger/dist/evidence/visual.test.js packages/ledger/dist/optimization/*.test.js packages/mcp/dist/optimization.lifecycle.test.js packages/ui/lib/experiment-chart.test.mjs packages/ledger/dist/session/visual-evidence.break.test.js packages/ledger/dist/session/evidence.break.test.js packages/ui/lib/simplicity.break.test.mjs packages/ui/lib/check-evidence.test.mjs; exit 0, 45 passed. Unchanged alternate-allocation killer now passes after augmenting-path matching fix. Independently inspected T-045-desktop.png: passing metadata collapsed, description/actions and actual output clear. T-045-mobile.png: readable full-width description above actions, wrapped output, no horizontal clipping. T-045-missing.png: three exact missing surfaces and instruction to attach current screenshots prominently visible; supporting demo clearly historical. Shared evaluator confirms all three current T-045 surfaces satisfied. Prior additive experiment behavior, image limits, passive reads, failure/history honesty and retry identity remain green.
